activation_gates: Confirm actual installed distribution, exact revision and desktop artifact identity.
Independent review of plugin and its generated bytes.
Native Electron smoke test, including inherited CSP and frame behavior, without weakening policy.
Keep runtime routes disabled pending authenticated admission, bounded tools, egress and cancellation tests.
Resolve the existing release hold through the maintainer process before release.
limitations: No Hermes installation or native Electron execution performed.
A desktop plugin runs with full renderer authority; the child iframe sandbox does not sandbox its parent or all Hermes activity.
No host state, session, RPC, REST, socket, clipboard or storage interfaces are used by this candidate.
This route has no model input/output, context sync or credential channel.
A hash match establishes identical bytes, not authenticity, educational benefit or authorization.
Parent desktop CSP/header and packaged desktop supply-chain behavior require native verification.

The upstream SDK guide says no core plugins while the pinned tree includes plugin directories; exact contract code takes precedence for this narrow route, and broader documentation parity is unassessed.
